subject: Mobile Development
title: The Attention Economy
description: Learn The Attention Economy in one minute.

hook.text: The average person spends over 4 hours per day on their phone. Apps fight for every second.

buildup.text: Infinite scroll, autoplay, and push notifications are designed to maximize screen time.

discovery.text: Attention is the currency. The longer you stay, the more ads you see, the more revenue flows.

twist.text: Former tech executives admit they designed features to be as addictive as possible.

climax.text: Screen time tools now ship on every phone — built by the same companies that fuel the problem.

punchline.text: Your attention is the product being sold.

quiz.question: How much time does the average person spend on their phone daily?
